description: This file defines API interaction functions for a web frontend, including CRUD operations for work items and comments, as well as utility functions for request handling and URL construction.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if the provided API path is public (no Authorization required) or protected.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers for API requests, adding Authorization header for protected paths.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON, handling errors.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON payload to the backend and returns parsed JSON, with error handling.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returning parsed JSON and handling errors.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON payload to the backend and returns parsed JSON, handling errors.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item based on project ID and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from local storage or explicit argument.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug), including the creator info from local storage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item via PATCH request.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL given a path.
